units.source_text: 岛村认为这话不可靠，根本没有把它放在心上。

en.t: Shimamura thought the story was unreliable and did not take it to heart at all.

units.source_text: 约莫过了一个钟头，女佣把女子领来，岛村不禁一愣，正了正坐姿。

en.t: About an hour later, when the maid brought the woman in, Shimamura started in surprise and straightened his posture.

units.source_text: 女子拉住站起来就要走的女佣的袖子，让她依旧坐下。

en.t: The woman caught the sleeve of the maid who was standing up to leave and made her sit down again.
